evaluation: Retrospective rolling evaluation with reused historical outcomes; not a fresh holdout. Prospective validation required.
growth: Matched-window total ratio minus one, multiplied by 100. Unemployment is the difference in matched-window mean rates in percentage points.
missing: All required monthly values must be published. No imputation. Missing core prevents candidate prediction; incumbent remains available.
provinceEffects: Unpenalized province intercepts through within-province training centering. All eligible provinces enter the common slope fit.
scaling: Training-only within-province RMS scale; zero scales become one.
ridge: Penalty equals eligible training row count multiplied by candidate ratio 1 or 10.
pcr: Top two eigenvectors of the covariance of training-standardized eight monthly predictors, with standardized lag GDP retained directly. The three regression columns are re-scaled using training RMS; ridge penalty n*1.
quadratic: Clip training-standardized inputs at +/-5, append their squares, then centre each expanded feature within province and re-scale by its training RMS. Ridge penalty n*10. Identical learned transforms apply to the forecast row.
equalWeight: Equal average of all four available model predictions. No data-selected subset.
selection: For each province/horizon/origin, require at least five distinct earlier paired target years and at least 5% lower MAE plus non-worse RMSE against the full incumbent. Choose lowest MAE eligible candidate, ties in listed order; otherwise incumbent.
interval: Symmetric 80% empirical error range, radius at min(n,ceil((n+1)*0.8)) rank of absolute errors from that policy's earlier forecasts. At least five eligible earlier targets. No guarantee of future coverage.
production: No model admission until independent review; retain source hashes and prospective forecast receipt for future outcomes.
